Added 2026-05-06; demoted 2026-05-07 after a 302-to-login on every /api/ path. | 2026-05-07 (later): re-enabled. The SPA's HTTP 302/405 was caused by the routine container's User-Agent being filtered by the publisher; the dashboard's TLP:CLEAR slice is fully public when fetched with a normal browser User-Agent. Two endpoints serve the public slice anonymously: GET /api/posts/dashboard?pageSize=N&pageIndex=0 returns the listing, and GET /api/posts/{id}/details returns the full TLP:CLEAR Markdown body. The brief MUST cite the canonical SPA URL https://security-hub.ncsc.admin.ch/#/posts/{id} (not the API path). The repo ships tools/fetch_source.py as the documented bridge: `python3 tools/fetch_source.py ncsc-csh recent 10` returns listing + content in one call. Posts marked TLP:AMBER / TLP:RED MUST NEVER be fetched even if the API exposes them.

GovCERT.ch was MERGED INTO NCSC.ch in 2023; the standalone govcert.ch blog and the GitHub mirror at https://github.com/govcert-ch/website are FROZEN ARCHIVES (last commit 2023-09). The /govcert path on ncsc.admin.ch is a navigation page only (RFC 2350, PGP keys, contact addresses — no current advisories). Substantive technical reports are now published on the NCSC Cyber Security Hub (TLP:CLEAR slice). REQUIRED FETCH METHOD for both main agent AND every sub-agent: `python3 tools/fetch_source.py ncsc-csh recent 10` (returns the listing + each post's full Markdown body in one call) and `python3 tools/fetch_source.py ncsc-csh post <ID>` for one item. Cite the canonical SPA URL https://security-hub.ncsc.admin.ch/#/posts/{id}. Posts marked TLP:AMBER / TLP:RED MUST NEVER be fetched even if the API exposes them.

Federal Office for Information Security (Germany), CERT-Bund's WID advisory portal. The /portal/wid/kurzinformationen page is a JS-rendered SPA — WebFetch returns ONLY the 'Warn- und Informationsdienst' header with no advisory list. REQUIRED FETCH METHOD for both main agent AND every sub-agent: hit the RSS feed instead — `python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://wid.cert-bund.de/content/public/securityAdvisory/rss` (machine-readable, full advisory list with WID-SEC-YYYY-NNNN identifiers and links). For per-advisory detail, fetch `python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://wid.cert-bund.de/portal/wid/securityadvisory?name=WID-SEC-YYYY-NNNN`. **Never cite the kurzinformationen index** — always cite the per-advisory detail URL. Example: WID-SEC-2026-1232 = CVE-2026-31431 'Copy Fail'.

US public-company breach disclosures via Item 1.05; primary source. URL CORRECTED 2026-05-08: the legacy /cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany URL is a PER-COMPANY filing search box (useless for surfacing new breach filings across all registrants). Use the EDGAR full-text search API at https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=...&forms=8-K with date range parameters (&dateRange=custom&startdt=YYYY-MM-DD&enddt=YYYY-MM-DD). Best query strings: q=%22Item+1.05%22 (most precise — only material cyber incidents) or q=%22cybersecurity+incident%22 (broader). The API returns metadata only (no doc_text); drill into each match's per-company filing index at https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=<CIK>&type=8-K to read the actual filing. Cite the per-filing URL (e.g. /Archives/edgar/data/<CIK>/<accession>/...), not the search URL.
